capabilities: Toggle fullscreen focus mode for the current document
Restore the previous layout when exiting
Run the toggle from the command palette or a keyboard shortcut
Exit fullscreen by holding Esc for about 1.5 seconds
disambiguation: Not an OS or window fullscreen toggle; it hides the other panes so one document fills the view.
extras: The Esc behavior (quick press reaches the editor, long hold exits) does not work in popup windows.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to make one note fill the view while hiding the rest of the layout.
summary: Command that shows a single document in a fullscreen focus mode and restores the previous layout when toggled off.
